# Sevlumen PostgreSQL v1.1.0

This backward-compatible release adds the session and trusted migration-script capabilities required by Sevlumen ORM while preserving the dependency-free `database/sql` driver architecture.

## Added

- pinned `postgres.Session` acquisition for advisory locks and session-scoped operations;
- explicit backend discard when cleanup or protocol state cannot be trusted;
- trusted multi-statement execution through PostgreSQL's simple-query protocol;
- dollar-quoted procedural-body support and ordered command tags;
- PostgreSQL 14–18 integration coverage for session identity, transaction behavior, cancellation and pool reuse.

## Security boundaries

Application values remain on extended-query APIs and are encoded separately from SQL. `ExecScriptContext` accepts no parameters and is exclusively for developer-authored migration SQL. Request data, tenant data, credentials and other untrusted values must never be concatenated into scripts.

Canceled or protocol-uncertain script backends are discarded before `database/sql` can reuse them. Ambiguous network outcomes continue to surface as `postgres.ErrOperationOutcomeUnknown` and must not be retried blindly.

## Compatibility

- Go 1.23 and current stable Go;
- Linux, macOS and Windows;
- PostgreSQL 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18;
- no runtime dependencies, CGo, `pgx` or `libpq`.

The release assets contain a deterministic source archive, exact source commit and SHA-256 checksums.
